name: Lusca
description: The Lusca is a marine cryptid of Bahamian and Caribbean folklore, said to inhabit the blue holes of Andros Island and surrounding waters. It is most often described as a gigantic octopus or a half-octopus, half-shark or half-dragon hybrid, and is blamed locally for the deaths of swimmers, divers and small craft drawn into blue-hole tidal currents.
origin: Lusca legends are concentrated on Andros Island, Bahamas, and extend through the Bahamas and the wider Caribbean wherever blue holes and cave systems exist.
